tasks.title: Thrust-to-weight ratio T/W
tasks.statement: Four motors with **{tm} g** of maximum thrust each, takeoff mass **{m} g**. Find T/W.

tasks.title: Hover time
tasks.statement: Mass **{m} g**, hover efficiency **{e} g/W**, battery **{c}S {cap} mAh**, electronics 0.8 A, we use 80% of the capacity. Estimate the hover time (min), U = 3.7 V per cell.
tasks.solution: P = m/e; I = P/(S·3.7) + I_electronics; t = 0.8·C / I.
